original_approval.instruction:
你直接帮忙把所有Math-Vision题目都加入正式题库吧（mashpalette-publish），然后如果题目里面有<image1>这种标记要删去。
记得标记来源。

hypotheses_considered_and_rejected.hypothesis: Group27unit seams as9+18, bind to candidate ends
hypotheses_considered_and_rejected.reason: This repeats the old explicit grouping assessment; every option is shorter than9except10, and preserving all unit boundaries and numbers provides no new plausible unique false match.

hypotheses_considered_and_rejected.hypothesis: Always select the longer child, making27->18->12->8
hypotheses_considered_and_rejected.reason: Would falsely eliminate several of2/4/6rather than single out one wrong option. Marking only8would be arbitrary option emphasis.

hypotheses_considered_and_rejected.hypothesis: Align a9unit input run to the8unit D silhouette
hypotheses_considered_and_rejected.reason: The actual run endpoint differs by a full cube. Moving or hiding the endpoint/seam would alter length; exact honest contour alignment cannot be obtained.

hypotheses_considered_and_rejected.hypothesis: Color repeated2:1subgroups on the answer sticks
hypotheses_considered_and_rejected.reason: A ratio subgroup that is geometrically true helps the correct reachability calculation; false cut lines would add a new piece partition. No clean distinct semantic repair found.

reason_for_no_forced_call: No clean materially new hypothesis after the finite review; quota/cost not a stopping reason.
